يحتوشوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَوِشُوا (yaḥtawišū) /jaħ.ta.wi.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# يُحْتَوَشُوا (yuḥtawašū) /juħ.ta.wa.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
